race.comment: JUST COMET (6) brings the most persuasive recent form, beaten just over half a length at Gawler last start after placing at this track the run prior. She has already placed once at this distance range and has held her form through seven starts without quite breaking through. Gets her chance. DON'T SAY DO (4) went within a nose of winning at Jamestown and gets a 2kg apprentice claim, though she now has to transfer that picnic-level near miss into harder company. Can contest. ASHEN GLOW (1) was safely held fresh at Mt Gambier but has BM68 form in the background and has placed at this distance. In the mix. REGAL TIME (9) is on the quick back-up and did close off at Balaklava. The apprentice claim helps and is worth throwing in for a value bet. INTIMUS (11) both rides with Teagan Voorham have produced placings. in the mix.
